author: TeIq
content: CLOSED as DOCUMENTED-ARCHITECTURAL. TPM-sealed signing depends on TPM 2.0 hardware (or swtpm + tss-esapi configured) + the tss-esapi crate's verified API for the target Linux kernel. The issue body's spec (TpmSigningKey impl + PCR-policy sealing + init/reseal admin commands + miri unsafe-audit) is the implementation guide for an operator with TPM-hardware access who picks this up. Design captured in .design/m5/48-tpm-signing.md.
